name: Register Goat + Record Weight Offline + Sync + Search
architecture_lock_note: Gates VS-01–VS-20 remain the 3 September 2026 pre-lock Supabase/Meilisearch proof. Gates VS-21–VS-24 are the locked local-first slice (Room + LAN/Drive contract + local search). FEATURE_GREEN remains false. Re-pin certificate_commit only after canonical CI on the local-first tests succeeds on main.
remaining_non_slice_limitations: VS-03 proves file-backed Room close/reopen, not a full physical handset reboot.
Second-device proof uses two isolated Room databases on one emulator, not two physical devices.
Inter is bundled at core/design/src/main/res/font/inter_variable.ttf. VISUAL_GREEN remains 0 until native goldens have independent owner approval.
No Google Drive REST gateway is configured in this repository. Drive remains a transport contract plus tests.
Goat herd, profile, weight history, lifecycle, kidding, and farm-create fan-out are implemented but not FEATURE_GREEN.

Operating spine now has governed write paths for rabbit programme including palpation/kindling/foster/wean, nest-box cycle, kits/retention, waitlist/contracts, market-plan records (no ADG projection), bedding/feed inventory binds (no auto-issue on nest place), and GI-stasis red-flag observation plus vet-call task, sheep joining/scan/lambing/marking/weaning/wool/shearing/dag/footrot/flystrike/FAMACHA/micron, cattle service/PD/calving/BCS/milk/locomotion/SCC/dry-off/weaning/days-on-feed/lot place and close-out, goat milk/BCS/SCC/heat/mating/+45 pregnancy-check, +7 lactation follow-up, and kid records capped to live kids with a dam pedigree link, official identifiers and cattle/sheep movements, FEFO dated-lot receive/issue with no silent non-lot fallback plus reorder-point records, vet visits and lab results as records not diagnoses, poultry kind enable plus earlier flock/hatch/vax/placement/biosecurity, record-only pedigree links with no COI engine, protocol-pack slots that generate due tasks on apply, group census, procurement purchases, protocol packs, and treatment withdrawal windows, plus earlier identity/weight/status, tasks, health, pasture, labour, assets, feed, water, sales, money, and inventory. These are not FEATURE_GREEN.

AI adapters, hardware adapters, Drive REST, candidate ranking, share/Drive export, and mixed-farm field certification remain unimplemented or uncertified. COI, reports CSV/PDF, Roborazzi capture, and local search exist as uncertified implementation.
